messages:
Asha (CSM): Hi team — kicking off the Omnidocs onboarding thread. Objectives: connect their ingestion pipeline, validate data residency, and run a 2-week pilot with 50k queries/day target. Who's on point for compliance checks?
Derek (Implementation Eng): I'll own the ingestion and pilot infra. Planning to spin a staging cluster in their eu-west VPC. Need list of approved datasets from Priya.
Priya (Customer Lead - Omnidocs): Sending the dataset list in a moment. Important: several records have EU residency flags and one bucket is in our Dublin account.
Luna (Security Engineer): @Priya please confirm if Dublin bucket is GDPR-compliant and whether encryption uses customer-managed keys (CMK). If CMK, we'll need KMS ARNs.
Priya (Customer Lead - Omnidocs): It's CMK-managed. I'll DM the key ARNs and an excerpt of their DPA.
Mateo (Success Ops): FYI, renewal is in 10 months and procurement flagged potential budget freeze. If pilot shows latency <150ms 95p and cost < $0.02/token unit, it helps the renewal case. Let's capture those as success criteria.
Asha (CSM): Noted. Success criteria draft: 1) ingest X files/day with <1% error, 2) tail latency <200ms 95p for our demo prompts, 3) pilot throughput >=50k QPD, 4) no compliance blockers for EU data. Agree?
Sam (PM - Integrations): Agree with metrics. Add: integration SDKs must be handed off with an example webhook and retry logic. I'll own the SDK sample.
Derek (Implementation Eng): Timeline proposal: Week 1 - staging and ingest tests; Week 2 - integration + security signoff; Week 3 - pilot ramp to 50k QPD; Week 4 - demo + success metrics review. Thoughts?
Asha (CSM): Week-by-week looks good. Can we push security signoff into end of week 2 so pilot ramp starts earliest Monday of week 3?
Luna (Security Engineer): Sounds fine. I'll schedule a short security review on Thursday of week 2. Need access to a sample payload and threat model.
Priya (Customer Lead - Omnidocs): I'll produce sample payloads by Monday (redacted where necessary). Also cc'ing legal offline for the DPA Qs.
onboard-playbook-bot: Created onboarding checklist: https://redwood.internal/onboard/omnidocs-1769801234 - contains tasks, owners, and SLO targets.
Asha (CSM): Great. Mateo — can you add the renewal risk tag and track procurement engagement? Maybe a short exec summary at pilot midpoint.
Mateo (Success Ops): On it. I'll add a procurement touchpoint in week 2 and draft a 1-pager for the execs by week 3 midpoint.
Derek (Implementation Eng): Quick config note for staging: using continuous batching + KV cache enabled. Sample command to spin the job: `rwictl deploy --env staging --model xlarge --kv-cache --autoscale min=2,max=8`.
Sam (PM - Integrations): Adding SDK checklist: auth example, retry/backoff, example webhook, and sample prompt templates. Will PR by Tue.
Asha (CSM): Logistics: propose a weekly 30m sync on Wednesdays 10:00am PT. If that works, calendar-bot please create recurring invite for these participants.
calendar-bot: Recurring invite created: Wednesdays 10:00am PT, attendees: Asha, Derek, Priya, Sam, Luna, Mateo.
Priya (Customer Lead - Omnidocs): Wed 10 PT works. Thanks all. Looking forward to the pilot. :rocket:
Asha (CSM): Closing next steps: Priya share datasets + ARNs by Mon; Derek to confirm staging infra by Tue; Sam to PR SDK by Tue; Luna schedule security review Thu Wk2; Mateo procurement touchpoint Wk2. I'll update the onboard checklist with these owners.
Derek (Implementation Eng): Ping me if you need a test token or CORS rules.
Asha (CSM): Thanks everyone — adding notes to the playbook and we'll reconvene on Wednesday. :thumbsup:
